name: Tartan
description: A tartan sett: warp bands of three widths crossed by a translucent weft in the same order, mixing where they meet, under a fine light overcheck.

code.style: --rule: ( --ka: @pd(@p(var(--color1), var(--color2))); --kb: @pd(@p(var(--color3), var(--color4))); --kc: @pd(@p(var(--color5), var(--color6))); --ko: @pd(@p(var(--color5), var(--color6))); --wx: @match((x) % 4 == 0, @var(--ka), (x) % 4 == 1, @var(--kb), (x) % 4 == 2, @var(--kc), @var(--kb)); --wy: @match((y) % 4 == 0, @var(--ka), (y) % 4 == 1, @var(--kb), (y) % 4 == 2, @var(--kc), @var(--kb)); --sx: @match(x % 4 == 0, 64%, x % 4 == 2, 24%, 42%); --sy: @match(y % 4 == 0, 64%, y % 4 == 2, 24%, 42%); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: @var(--sx); background-color: @p(@var(--wx)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-color: @var(--wy); background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 84%, @var(--ko) 84% 88%, transparent 88%), linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 84%, @var(--ko) 84% 88%, transparent 88%); opacity: .6; -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0 @var(--sy), transparent @var(--sy)), linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0, transparent 84%, #000 84% 88%, transparent 88%), linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0, transparent 84%, #000 84% 88%, transparent 88%); mask: linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0 @var(--sy), transparent @var(--sy)), linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0, transparent 84%, #000 84% 88%, transparent 88%), linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0, transparent 84%, #000 84% 88%, transparent 88%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
